outcome: need for secondary medications (phenobarbital or clonidine)
cohort: The study included infants born at or after 35 weeks' gestation who were admitted to the NICU for Neonatal Opioid Withdrawal Syndrome (NOWS) treatment between 2011 and 2022.
finding: Buprenorphine treatment for NOWS was associated with significantly shorter lengths of treatment and hospital stay compared to morphine treatment.
